brief.title: Frontier AI Models Compared: Intelligence, Speed & Cost
brief.one_liner: A data-driven comparison of the top 10 frontier AI language models across intelligence, output speed, and pricing based on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.0.
brief.goal: Viewers should quickly understand the trade-offs between intelligence, speed, and cost among leading AI models, enabling informed decisions about which model best fits their use case.

sections.title: Intelligence Rankings
sections.objective: Present the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index scores for the top 10 models, highlighting the leaders and the gap between tiers.

sections.title: Output Speed Comparison
sections.objective: Show output tokens per second for each model, revealing that the fastest models are not necessarily the most intelligent.

sections.title: Pricing Landscape
sections.objective: Display the cost per 1M tokens for each model, emphasizing the wide range from $0.30 to $10.00 and the value propositions of budget vs. premium models.

sections.title: The Intelligence–Speed–Cost Trade-Off
sections.objective: Synthesize the three dimensions to highlight which models offer the best balance and which excel in a single dimension.

sections.title: About the Index
sections.objective: Briefly explain the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.0 methodology and the 10 evaluations it incorporates.
